name: Yar

facts.text: Yar is a level-73 named with 40,000 health in the southwest of Malmohus (region 100 at 695353, 1022775).
At 30% health he calls drakulv executioners, soultrappers and disciples to his aid.
The quest 'Yar the Firstborn' (from Kiaja at Svarhamr) calls him the oldest and strongest of the drakulv, the most powerful of the werewolves, and says to bring an adequate force.
A Dec 2002 Allakhazam comment says killing Yar reduces the chance of Gjalpinulva's exhale (unverified hearsay); a 2003 comment says one good crowd-control group can do him.
Swedish drake means dragon and ulv wolf (the compound 'drakulv' to verify).

story:
Yar was the first. Before the drakulv were a people, before there were armguards and axehands and soultrappers and priests, there was one pup in the ruins with scales on its back and a wolf's grin, and Gjalpinulva licked the frost off it and named it. He is the oldest of her brood and the strongest, and the svartalfar of Svarhamr, who keep the old tales of Malmohus, call him the most powerful of all the werewolves, the firstborn of the wolf's daughter. He wears his mother's look more than any of his kin: the long wolf's head, the scaled back, the frozen eyes.

He hunts the southwest of Malmohus with his kin around him, and the drakulv of the camps there are his: executioners and soultrappers and disciples who would die for him and often have. He is a fighter, not a priest or a sorcerer; he trusts his claws and his strength and the loyalty of his blood. When he is hurt badly, at less than a third of his strength, he howls, and the drakulv come running, an executioner, a soultrapper and a disciple, because the firstborn has never once called and not been answered. If the fight leaves him alone for long, he is whole again in a minute; the firstborn heals as his mother does.

The svartalfar of Svarhamr pay well for his head. Kiaja, who keeps the dragonbane's trust, will send any friend of the svartalfar after him, with a warning to bring an adequate force, and Raxnathor will reward whoever comes back. They say his mother feels it when he dies. They say that is the point: a dragon in grief breathes less carefully. The raid leaders of old turned that into a habit, and killed Yar on the way to every dragon fight, and swore by it. Whether it ever helped, nobody can prove. His head makes a fine wall trophy, and the drakulv never forgive whoever carries it.
legend: Yar's a group fight with good crowd control: one good CC group can do him, a 2003 comment said. At 30% he shouts and his kin come, an executioner, a soultrapper and a disciple, so have mez ready and save power. He resets fully after a minute out of combat, so don't let the fight stall. The svartalf quest Yar the Firstborn from Kiaja at Svarhamr sends you after him once your faction is good enough. Raid leaders used to kill Yar on the way to the dragon because they swore it made her breathe less. Nobody ever proved it. His head makes a fine wall trophy, and the wulfen gear he drops is good.

aggro: Firstborn of the Wolf's Daughter! You are in my mother's ruins!
Mother's ruins. Mother's frost. Mother's son.
The svartalfar sent you? They always send someone.
slay: Another head for Svarhamr's wall? No. Mine.

lairEntry: Old claw-marks scar the stones. The firstborn hunts here.
Drakulv camps surround a tall figure with frozen eyes.

phases.text: Yar howls, and the drakulv come running!
Yar falls. Far off, the dragon stirs.

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Yar the Firstborn is slain. Somewhere, his mother stirs.

loremasterTopic.text: The firstborn of [Gjalpinulva]'s brood, the oldest and strongest of the drakulv. When he howls, his kin come. The svartalfar say his mother feels it when he dies.

bookPage: From the quest-book of Kiaja of Svarhamr, as a Midgard warrior copied it. 'We thank you. This is an act of great bravery my people will not soon forget.' That is what she said when I came back with the firstborn's head. Then she said I should speak with Skipta, who had earned their trust years before, and that we might share more than I knew. I asked Skipta what Kiaja meant. Skipta said that everyone who kills the firstborn dreams of the mother afterwards, and that the dragonbane keep a list of those who dream. She said my name was on it now.
